notes:
Inbound from sales enablement app maker. Using webhooks -> records calls, auto-transcribe + create meeting notes. Interested in Redwood hosted API for self-serve / low-friction onboarding. Key concerns: PII in transcripts (SSNs, credit cards, emails), retention duration, ability to purge, and encryption at rest.

Call summary (02/12) w/ AE + founder: "We cannot ship transcripts that contain credit card numbers or SSNs to a third-party without strong redaction controls." Wants default retention <= 30 days for raw transcripts, longer retention for sanitized summaries.

Technical notes from discovery: currently using AWS Transcribe + custom redaction pipeline. Looking to replace part of workflow with Redwood text generation for summarization and entity extraction. Primary workflow: call recordings -> speech-to-text -> Redwood summarization API -> store summary in app DB. Wants confirmation that Redwood hosted API: (1) will not persist raw audio/transcripts beyond retention window, (2) supports request-level retention/purge requests, (3) supports KMS-backed encryption for stored artifacts (if any).

Cost sensitivity: SMB price-conscious. Will likely start with self-serve API keys and low volume PoC (~500 calls/month) then scale. Latency: acceptable up to 2s per summarization call for near-real-time UI. Throughput: bursty (end of day uploads). Model preference: smaller open models ok if quality high; willing to test quantized variants to cut cost.

Quotes / paraphrases: "Prefer hosted to avoid infra ops — but cannot compromise on PII handling." "Need a simple opt-out/purge flow for customers who request transcript deletion."

Documents shared: pricing_deck_calllens_v1.pdf (drive), security_faq_redwood.pdf (requested). Sent Redwood hosted API quickstart link and security FAQ. AE flagged for SE follow-up to deep-dive retention controls and demo PoC key.
